beats.care: Renting a PG or flat? Look for cracks and extra floors, and ask the owner about MCD approvals.
beats.what: Between Sept 6 and Oct 10, MCD acted on 1,046 properties across all 12 zones, a Delhi government statement said.
beats.why: The drive follows CM Rekha Gupta's directions. An unsafe building in Seemapuri was razed after a collapse there.

cards.body: Rohini zone led demolition action with 158, then South zone with 121.
cards.caption: properties acted on

cards.body: CM Rekha Gupta said there would be no compromise on citizens' safety and the drive will continue citywide. DUSIB served notices on three more houses after the Seemapuri collapse.
City-SP zone saw the most sealing: 87 properties, more than double any other zone.

cards.q: What does it mean when MCD 'seals' a property?
cards.why: Sealing stops use of a building or part of it until the violation is sorted out.

hook: *47 unsafe buildings* razed in Delhi in a month. Is your PG safe?

learn.t: Karol Bagh zone, packed with PGs and coaching centres, had the most dangerous buildings razed: 13 of 47.
